suggested_fix: No fix needed. The function already uses a large RX buffer when the max frame size exceeds the build_skb limit, when 2K buffers are too small once padding is added, or when the Store Bad Packet (E1000_RCTL_SBP) bit is set. Because of the SBP check, oversized frames that the NIC accepts in store-bad-packet mode cannot overflow a 2K buffer. (The '#if' lines here appear commented out, so the matching '#endif' lines are unbalanced. That is a preprocessing artifact of this sample, not a security flaw.)
